name: get_aviation_weather
description: Get live aviation weather (METAR observation and TAF forecast) for one or more airports. Use ICAO codes, e.g. DNMM (Lagos), EGLL (London Heathrow), OMDB (Dubai), HAAB (Addis Ababa), LTFM (Istanbul). Use this for delay-risk questions and to decode METAR/TAF.

name: get_destination_forecast
description: Get the daily weather forecast (up to 16 days ahead) for a destination city: max/min temperature in C, rain chance, wind. Use it for packing advice and destination weather.

name: search_flights
description: Search live flight offers and fares between two airports. Returns price, airline, stops, layover minutes, total duration, baggage, fare brand and change/refund conditions. Use IATA airport or city codes (LOS, LHR, LON, DXB, NBO).

origin.description: IATA code of the departure airport or city

destination.description: IATA code of the arrival airport or city

return_date.description: Optional return date YYYY-MM-DD for round trips

max_connections.description: 0 for nonstop only, 1 for up to one stop (default 1)

max_results.description: How many offers to return (default 6, max 10)

name: plan_trip_timeline
description: Build a departure-day timeline: when to leave home, arrive at the airport, check-in and bag-drop closing, security, boarding and gate closing. Handles time zones.

departure_time_local.description: Local departure time, ISO format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the departure airport, e.g. Africa/Lagos

checked_bags.description: True if the traveller is checking bags

travel_minutes_to_airport.description: Travel time from home to the airport in minutes

name: create_calendar_file
description: Create a calendar file (.ics) with trip events and reminders, and return a download link the user can open to add everything to Google, Outlook or Apple calendar.

name: get_country_info
description: Facts about a country: official currency (code, name, symbol), languages spoken, capital, time zones, international calling code, driving side. Use it whenever you mention a destination's currency or language.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. 'France', 'GB', 'Ghana'

name: get_exchange_rate
description: Today's reference exchange rate and conversion between two currencies (ISO codes). Use for every price conversion.

name: search_ground_transport
description: Find scheduled buses, trains or other public transport between two places (cities, stations, addresses or airports) with operators, times, duration and fares where published.

modes.description: Any of BUS, RAIL, TRAIN, SUBWAY, LIGHT_RAIL (default BUS)

language.description: Optional language code for names, e.g. en, fr

name: get_flight_status
description: Live status of a flight by flight number: scheduled and estimated times, delays, terminal and gate.

flight_number.description: IATA flight number, e.g. P47120, BA74

name: create_booking_request
description: Record a booking request (bus, flight, airport transfer, translator, hotel, tour) for the Airxpact team to confirm with the traveller. Only call after the traveller confirmed all details, name and contact. Returns a booking reference.

booking_type.description: bus, flight, airport_transfer, translator, hotel, tour or other

details.description: Everything the team needs: route, times, operator, language pair, budget, special needs

name: get_booking_status
description: Status of an earlier booking request by its reference (AXP-XXXXXX).
